gate: Metric-Origin Branch Stop / Minimal Ensemble Axiom and HLCB Dependency Gate

minimal_explicit_metric_input.name: MEA — Minimal Ensemble Axiom
minimal_explicit_metric_input.shape_clause: BIFL: physical score second moment is isotropic under the full BKM isometry group, so q_i is proportional to K_i^-1
minimal_explicit_metric_input.normalization_clause: one universal positive per-protected-source second-moment constant c_*

local_SMI.statement: Because v12.99 SSQRT constructs q directly as a quadratic form on the same RESA solder fiber, MEA-selected q is already on the matched retained germ. Choosing e with e^T e=q is then a coframe representation, not an independent identification ansatz.

QTC.name: QTC — Quadratic Transport Compatibility
QTC.orientation_convention: O_ij maps V_j to V_i; metric compatibility is q_j=O_ij^T q_i O_ij
QTC.theorem: Local MEA/BIFL selection at each vertex does not imply that neighboring score metrics are related by the retained O_ij. If QTC holds, the induced transport S_i O_ij S_j^-1 is orthogonal in q-orthonormal frames; if QTC fails, no coframe gauge can repair generic spectral-shape mismatch.

universal_constant_scale.meaning: A global/universal positive constant c_* cancels from q-orthonormal transport and leaves the Levi-Civita connection unchanged.

state_or_node_dependent_scale.meaning: A varying normalization is geometric: it changes the connection and generically creates a Weyl/non-metric contribution.

normalization_role.HLCB_dependency: The numerical value of a universal c_* is not needed to test connection equality/torsion zero. Universality/constancy is needed; absolute scale remains needed for physical distance and dimensional curvature normalization.

coframe_gauge_theorem.theorem: For e'=R e and omega'=R omega R^-1-dR R^-1, Cartan torsion transforms as T'=R T. Hence TFHC T=0 is independent of square-root/coframe gauge; nonzero contorsion cannot be hidden by choosing a different q-orthonormal frame.

HLCB_dependency_reduction.local_metric_selection: MEA/BIFL (absolute c_* value optional for connection test if universal)
HLCB_dependency_reduction.theorem: MEA + QTC makes the relational connection a genuine O(3) connection on the selected q-orthonormal frame bundle. HLCB then reduces exactly to TFHC. If TFHC passes, omega_R=omega_LC(q); if it fails, the surviving antisymmetric defect is contorsion.

branch_stop.do_not_reopen_without: new ensemble/source-statistics primitive or external evidence
branch_stop.reason: v13.00 exhausted current BKM/naturality selection and v13.01 isolates the only downstream metric requirement relevant to the connection bridge as QTC, not further ensemble searching.

next_gate.name: Quadratic Transport Compatibility Origin / BKM-Holonomy Naturality Gate
next_gate.question: Does the retained pair transport O_ij naturally intertwine the local BKM score metrics K_i,K_j so that K_j=O_ij^T K_i O_ij (equivalently q_j=O_ij^T q_i O_ij under universal MEA scale)? If not, measure the induced non-metricity defect and stop any Levi-Civita identification before TFHC.
